description: Estimate the largest loan a borrower can afford from income and a target debt-to-income (DTI) ratio. Returns max monthly payment, max loan amount, and the rate used. If no rate is supplied, the current best market rate for the product/state is used.

dti.description: Target debt-to-income ratio as a decimal, e.g. 0.36

existing_monthly_debt.description: Optional existing monthly debt payments to subtract

product_type.description: Product for the market-rate lookup, default mortgage

rate.description: Optional annual interest rate, e.g. 6.5. If omitted, best market rate is used.

state.description: US state code (used to look up a market rate when rate is omitted)

name: max_loan

assumptions.description: The inputs the calculation rests on; state them alongside the number.

existing_monthly_debt.description: Existing monthly debt payments in dollars deducted from the DTI budget.

target_dti.description: Debt-to-income ratio targeted, as a decimal (0.43 = 43%).

term_months.description: Loan term in months used to convert the payment into a principal.

max_loan_amount.description: Largest loan principal in dollars that payment supports at the rate and term used. This is a loan amount, not a home price.

max_monthly_payment.description: Largest monthly payment in dollars the income supports at the target DTI, after subtracting existing debts.

note.description: Required caveat that this uses income and DTI only; lenders also weigh credit, down payment, and reserves.

rate_source.description: Where rate_used came from: 'provided' means the caller supplied it, 'market' means it was resolved from the best live published rate for this state and product.

rate_used.description: Interest rate, in percent, used for every calculation in this result. Check rate_source to see whether it came from the caller or from live market data.
